So I actually do not see any reason as to why are we getting forced to take this class. It is too time-consuming also, it has 3 midterms and a final, not including the homeworks. Although the students were from different departments, the course was taught as if all students were physics majors. This was not sufficiently taken into account in the way the course was delivered.

The exams were designed primarily to challenge students rather than to assess fundamental knowledge. They did not adequately reflect whether we understood the core concepts of the course. Exams were held very frequently, and the average scores were very low. This created significant stress among students and led to many being unfairly disadvantaged.

Although the course was offered as an elective, the teaching approach and assessment methods were not aligned with the student profile. There was almost no quantitative component in the course, which may have been intended to make it easier; however, I would have preferred quantitative questions. The exam questions were highly theoretical and often not directly related to the covered material. I also believe that the drastic change in the course content and assessment compared to previous years was unfair to our cohort. As a senior-year student, having to take four exams in a science course required a disproportionate amount of time and effort.

Herkesin ders vermemesinin gerekliliğini ve bunun öğrenciler üzerindeki yıkıcı olumsuz etkisini gösteren çok iyi bir örnek. 50 dakikalık dersin yaklaşık 7 dakikasını masa üzerinde duran notları ve tahta arasında gidip gelerek, 11 dakikasını da tahta önünde volta atarak geçirince bu dersin her hafta "işlenen" 4 saatinin hayatınızdan çalınmaktan başka birşey olmadığını anlıyorsunuz.  Ders başı geriye kalan 32 dakikada da sözde anlatılanları bir A.I aracılığı ile yazıya döktüğünüzde cidden sorunun sizde olmadığının farkına varıyorsunuz, çünkü metne dönüp baktığınızda yazının %40-60 civarının sadece "aaaa", "aaaaAAA", "hmmmm", "yes", "ja (almanca)" gibi çok anlamlı sözlerden oluşuyor. Ders sürecinde birşey öğrenememek çok sorun olmaz demeyin, inanınki ders sürecinde yapılan işlem hataları ve hocanın teorik arkaplan yetersizliği size bildiklerinizi de unutturacak.
